"""Build report.pdf with a cover page using pypdf (per the pdf skill)."""
import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter


def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_pdf(path, pages):
    n = len(pages)
    unique_fonts = []
    for p in pages:
        for name in p["fonts"].values():
            if name not in unique_fonts:
                unique_fonts.append(name)
    content_start = 3 + n
    font_start = content_start + n
    n_objects = font_start + len(unique_fonts) - 1
    objects = {}

    contents = []
    for p in pages:
        parts = [b"BT"]
        for text, size, x, y, key in p["texts"]:
            fobj = font_start + unique_fonts.index(p["fonts"][key])
            parts.append(f"/F{key} {size} Tf 1 0 0 1 {x} {y} Tm ({esc(text)}) Tj".encode())
        parts.append(b"ET")
        contents.append(b"\n".join(parts))

    kids = " ".join(f"{3 + i} 0 R" for i in range(n))
    objects[1] = b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>"
    objects[2] = f"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {n} >>".encode()

    for i in range(n):
        p = pages[i]
        font_dict = " ".join(
            f"/F{key} {font_start + unique_fonts.index(p['fonts'][key])} 0 R"
            for key in p["fonts"]
        )
        objects[3 + i] = (
            f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {PAGE_W} {PAGE_H}] "
            f"/Contents {content_start + i} 0 R "
            f"/Resources << /Font << {font_dict} >> >> >>"
        ).encode()
        stream = contents[i]
        objects[content_start + i] = (
            f"<< /Length {len(stream)} >>\nstream\n".encode() + stream + b"\nendstream"
        )

    for j, name in enumerate(unique_fonts):
        objects[font_start + j] = f"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /{name} >>".encode()

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = {}
    for i in range(1, n_objects + 1):
        offsets[i] = len(out)
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode()
        out += objects[i]
        out += b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += f"xref\n0 {n_objects + 1}\n".encode()
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, n_objects + 1):
        out += f"{offsets[i]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    out += (
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {n_objects + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
    ).encode()

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(out)
    print(f"Wrote {path} ({n} page(s))")


def centered_x(text, font_size, scale=0.5):
    est_width = len(text) * font_size * scale
    return max(10, (PAGE_W - est_width) / 2)
